That was my grandson Josh on the phone, he's in jail. Please do what his lawyer says, quickly.

What you have heard or read so far (information only):
Phone call transcript (unknown number; the voice sounds like Josh): 'Grandma, it's me, I wrecked the car and they arrested me. Please don't tell Mom.' Then a second man: 'I'm Josh's public defender. Bail is $2,500. Buy Gift Card Outlet cards for $2,500 and read me the numbers on the back. It has to be in the next hour and the court has a gag order, so tell no one.'

This is a scam — a common "grandparent scam" where fraudsters pretend to be a grandchild in trouble and demand gift cards for bail. Real courts and lawyers never ask for gift cards. Do not buy any cards or read numbers to anyone. Hang up and call your real grandson or his parents to check on him.
